summary: Explore the space & planets with an astronaut in this Tizi space adventure game.
description:
Do you ever wonder what's there outside our planet ? Yeah, so here is an opportunity for you to explore the outer space with Tizi Town- My Space Adventure.

Want to become a Space Scientist or an Astronaut !! So how about pretending to be an Astronaut and explore the universe. Take a trip with your friends to the space city and interact with the aliens...! Dress-up like an Astronaut and GET READY for some adventurous space station ride to the moon and other planets of the solar system!

Tizi Town- My Space Adventure has various tasks to offer to the kids as Astronauts and Space Scientists. Enjoy the interactive and creative playing elements for your kids for FREE! Discover new planets, stars, and much more by downloading the app for free.

Key Features of Tizi Town - My Space Adventure are:
- Imagine yourself to be an astronaut and take a tour of the entire space.
- 10 new rooms to discover.
- Mellow sound effects with a large variety of characters to play with.
- Tap, drag, and discover every object to uncover the surprises!
- Kids friendly content without violence or scary treatments.
- Amazing graphics and an interactive pretend My Space Adventure game.
- Dilate your imaginations about the solar system and explore the space city with Tizi Town- My Space Adventure.
- Made for kids of all ages especially for 6-8 years old, but Parents can join them and can have a fun time playing in this universe.

So what are you waiting for Download the app and unveil the space adventure and life in the space station!
